topics.title: College Quartet & Urine Trade
topics.summary: During college activities – football practice and frisbee games – a string quartet pauses while the Glee Club performs a promotional song for Atlantic Gas. Later, Howard discusses trading urine from his limousine decanter for $4000 with an unknown party, further fueling claims of exploitation.

topics.title: Morton Downey's Dubious Claims
topics.summary: A former medical doctor claims to be a KGB agent and FBI informant involved in goldmine scams while making outlandish statements about his past, including alleged connections with the Kennedys and attempts at launching a TV show. He repeatedly denies involvement with the FBI but admits to joking about it, claiming he was simply trying to ‘cop a plea,’ ultimately presenting an unbelievable narrative.

topics.title: Howard Discusses Cease and Desist & Martin Donny
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard discusses a cease-and-desist order with an unnamed individual regarding his refusal to sell, then transitions into criticizing radio host Martin Donny’s content—particularly his anti-abortion stance and comments about black people and abortion—as filled with "crap." The segment concludes with introductions of several young women who will be part of the live audience.

topics.title: Revealing Clothing Debate
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts engage in an uncomfortable discussion about revealing clothing and requesting guests to remove their tops. They debate the appropriateness of see-through garments and G-strings, leading to awkward requests for Lauren to go without her top.

topics.title: Radio Audition Chaos
topics.summary: A struggling performer attempts an impromptu radio audition, leading to bizarre requests for personal items and increasingly inappropriate interactions with callers. The segment devolves into chaotic wardrobe changes and a series of uncomfortable demands before abruptly ending.

topics.title: Morton Downey Jr.'s Chaotic Phone Call with Jackie Mason
topics.summary: During a chaotic phone call, Morton Downey Jr. discusses his failed limousine deal involving a questionable trade with Jackie Mason and a Hyundai car, claiming he was swindled out of the proceeds. He then launches into an incoherent rant about Lindsay’s appearance, her relationship with Howard Stern, bizarre accusations against black people while attempting to explain complex financial transactions, and engages in a heated debate with Jackie Mason regarding race relations and personal opinions.
